# Printautopilot

Print Autopilot enables seamless automation of printing tasks by connecting your applications directly to your printers.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/printautopilot/.

## Actions

- **List Queues** (read-only): List available PrintAutoPilot queues.
- **Upload File**: Upload a file to a temporary R2 bucket.
